entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna, party-minded, drawn from the druids and bards of Old Capenna.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city-plane with five crime families.

entities.name: Old Capenna
entities.description: Earlier era where the Cabaretti were druids.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: Leonin boss of the Cabaretti; adoptive father of Jinnie Fay.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Briefly an agent of the Maestros.

entities.name: Crescendo
entities.description: New year celebration, grandest of Cabaretti parties.

events.summary: In Old Capenna the Cabaretti serve as druids; leaving nature, festivals become constant parties.
events.quote: During the time of Old Capenna, the Cabaretti served as the plane's druids.

events.summary: Rumors spread of a renewable font of halo and an Angel returned in Cabaretti hands.
events.quote: Rumors of a new source of halo, a renewable font, threatens the balance of the families.

events.summary: The Cabaretti are unmentioned during Atraxa's slaughter, though Jetmir remains active.
events.quote: The Cabaretti were conspicuously unmentioned by the defenders of Capenna during Atraxa's slaughter.

relations.quote: briefly, as an agent of the Maestros
